001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
008 * Limits how many events a route keeps per second, like a token bucket. A burst of up
009 * to <code>maxBurst</code> events is kept, after which events are kept at
010 * <code>rate</code> per second until the burst is earned back. Events more severe
011 * than <code>level</code> are always kept. Time is measured with event timestamps,
012 * with a minimum interval of one nanosecond.
013 * <table class="table">
014 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
015 * <tr>
016 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
017 * <th>Type</th>
018 * <th>Required</th>
019 * <th>Default</th>
020 * <th>Description</th>
021 * </tr>
022 * <tr>
023 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.rate" }</code></td>
024 * <td><code>Integer</code></td>
025 * <td><code>true</code></td>
026 * <td>{@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter#DEFAULT_RATE }</td>
027 * <td>Events kept per second once a burst is used up.</td>
028 * </tr>
029 * <tr>
030 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.maxBurst" }</code></td>
031 * <td><code>Integer</code></td>
032 * <td><code>true</code></td>
033 * <td>{@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_BURST }</td>
034 * <td>Events kept at once before the rate applies.</td>
035 * </tr>
036 * <tr>
037 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.level" }</code></td>
038 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
039 * <td><code>true</code></td>
040 * <td>{@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#WARNING warning}, so errors are always kept</td>
041 * <td>The most severe level that is throttled.</td>
042 * </tr>
043 * </table>
044 */
045public final class ThrottleFilterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<ThrottleFilterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter> {
046
047        /**
048         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
049         * this prefix.
050         */
051        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.";
052        
053        /**
054         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_rate } = java.lang.Integer</code> Events kept per second once a burst is used up.
055         */
056        static final String PROPERTY_rate = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "rate";
057        /**
058         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_maxBurst } = java.lang.Integer</code> Events kept at once before the rate applies.
059         */
060        static final String PROPERTY_maxBurst = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "maxBurst";
061        /**
062         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_level } = java.lang.System.Logger.Level</code> The most severe level that is throttled.
063         */
064        static final String PROPERTY_level = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "level";
065        
066        private final String propertyPrefix;
067        final String property_rate;
068        final String property_maxBurst;
069        final String property_level;
070        
071        private final java.lang.String name;
072        private final java.lang.String filter;
073        private java.lang.Integer rate = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.DEFAULT_RATE;
074        private java.lang.Integer maxBurst = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.DEFAULT_MAX_BURST;
075        private java.lang.System.Logger.Level level = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.DEFAULT_LEVEL;
076        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable LogMetrics metrics;
077        
078        /**
079         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
080         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.</code>. Route name.
081         * @param filter will fill <code>{filter}</code> in <code>logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.</code>. Name the filter is selected with.
082         */
083        public ThrottleFilterBuilder(
084                        java.lang.String name
085                        , java.lang.String filter
086                        ) {
087                try {
088                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
089                                        "name", name
090                                        , "filter", filter
091                                );
092                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
093                        this.name = name;
094                        this.filter = filter;
095                        property_rate = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_rate, prefixParameters);
096                        property_maxBurst = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_maxBurst, prefixParameters);
097                        property_level = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_level, prefixParameters);
098                }
099                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
100                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
101                }
102        }
103
104
105        /**
106         * Sets metrics.
107         * Where to count dropped events as {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics#EVENTS_THROTTLED_METRIC}.
108         * Default is <code>null</code>.
109         * @param metrics not configurable through properties Where to count dropped events as {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics#EVENTS_THROTTLED_METRIC}.
110         * @return this builder.
111         */
112        public ThrottleFilterBuilder metrics(io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable LogMetrics metrics) {
113                this.metrics = metrics;
114                return this;
115        }
116
117        
118        /**
119         * Sets <strong>required</strong> rate.
120         * Events kept per second once a burst is used up.
121         * Default is {@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter#DEFAULT_RATE }.
122         * @param rate <code>{@value #PROPERTY_rate } = java.lang.Integer</code> Events kept per second once a burst is used up.
123         * @return this builder.
124         */
125        public ThrottleFilterBuilder rate(java.lang.Integer rate) {
126                this.rate = rate;
127                return this;
128        }
129        
130        /**
131         * Sets <strong>required</strong> maxBurst.
132         * Events kept at once before the rate applies.
133         * Default is {@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_BURST }.
134         * @param maxBurst <code>{@value #PROPERTY_maxBurst } = java.lang.Integer</code> Events kept at once before the rate applies.
135         * @return this builder.
136         */
137        public ThrottleFilterBuilder maxBurst(java.lang.Integer maxBurst) {
138                this.maxBurst = maxBurst;
139                return this;
140        }
141        
142        /**
143         * Sets <strong>required</strong> level.
144         * The most severe level that is throttled.
145         * Default is {@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#WARNING warning}, so errors are always kept.
146         * @param level <code>{@value #PROPERTY_level } = java.lang.System.Logger.Level</code> The most severe level that is throttled.
147         * @return this builder.
148         */
149        public ThrottleFilterBuilder level(java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
150                this.level = level;
151                return this;
152        }
153        
154        /**
155         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter } from this builder.
156         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
157         */
158        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter build() {
159                try {
160                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.of(
161                                        this.name
162                                        , this.filter
163                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_rate, this.rate)
164                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_maxBurst, this.maxBurst)
165                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_level, this.level)
166                                        , this.metrics
167                                        );
168                }
169                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
170                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
171                }
172        }
173        
174        @Override
175        public ThrottleFilterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
176                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
177                var _rate = properties.forKey(property_rate).ofInt().or(this.rate).validate(__v);
178                var _maxBurst = properties.forKey(property_maxBurst).ofInt().or(this.maxBurst).validate(__v);
179                var _level = properties.forKey(property_level).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.parseLevel(_v)).or(this.level).validate(__v);
180                __v.validate();
181                this.rate = _rate.value();
182                this.maxBurst = _maxBurst.value();
183                this.level = _level.value();
184                return this;
185        }
186        
187        /**
188         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
189         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
190         */
191        @Override
192        public String propertyPrefix() {
193                return this.propertyPrefix;
194        }
195        
196}
